name: audit-fixture-nextjs-minimal
_comment: Phase 2 hoisted compat audit. Peer-heavy fixture: Next.js + React. Next has the deepest peer-dep chain of the major JS frameworks. Originally also pulled eslint-config-next for plugin-chain coverage, but that depends on @rushstack/eslint-patch which doesn't support ESLint 9 — fixture-ecosystem incompatibility, not an lpm bug. ESLint plugin-chain coverage is provided by tooling/eslint-flat-config, which uses ESLint 9 directly without the rushstack patch layer.
